_meta.price_unit: per batch of up to 100 names

description: [Compliance & counterparty] Re-screen a whole customer, supplier or payee list against sanctions and US export-control lists in one call. Use for onboarding backlogs or periodic re-screening. Price: $0.50 per batch of up to 100 names (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/sanctions-batch

include_export_control.description: Also screen the US Consolidated Screening List (default true)

names.description: Names separated by ';' or newlines (GET), or a JSON array in POST body (max 100)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: batch_sanctions_screen
title: Batch Sanctions + Export-Control Screening (up to 100 names) ($0.50)
